mapper.sql: SELECT SDV.VALUE AS COST_TYPE, AC.OUTLAY AS OUTLAY FROM account_cost AC LEFT JOIN account_cost_user ACU ON AC.ID = ACU.COST_ID LEFT JOIN SYS_DICT_VALUE SDV ON SDV.DICT_KEY = 'ACCOUNT_COST_TYPE' AND SDV.VALUE_NAME = AC.COST_TYPE

SELECT AC.OUTLAY AS OUTLAY, DATE_FORMAT(AC.PAYMENT_TIME, '%Y-%m-%d') AS PAYMENT_TIME, CONCAT(STR_TO_DATE(AC.PAYMENT_TIME, '%Y-%m-%d'), '(', SDV.VALUE_NAME, ')') AS X_AXIS FROM account_cost AC LEFT JOIN account_cost_user ACU ON AC.ID = ACU.COST_ID LEFT JOIN sys_dict_value SDV ON SDV.DICT_KEY = 'WEEK_DAY' AND SDV.VALUE = WEEKDAY(STR_TO_DATE(AC.PAYMENT_TIME, '%Y-%m-%d')) + 1

SELECT AC.OUTLAY AS OUTLAY, DATE_FORMAT(AC.PAYMENT_TIME, '%Y-%m-%d') AS PAYMENT_TIME, DATE_FORMAT(AC.PAYMENT_TIME, '%Y-%m-%d') AS X_AXIS FROM account_cost AC LEFT JOIN account_cost_user ACU ON AC.ID = ACU.COST_ID

SELECT AC.OUTLAY, CONCAT(CURDATE(), ' 00:00:00') AS DURATION_FROM, CONCAT(CURDATE(), ' 23:59:59') AS DURATION_TO FROM account_cost AC LEFT JOIN account_cost_user ACU ON AC.ID = ACU.COST_ID WHERE 1 = 1 AND AC.LOGIC_DEL = 0 AND AC.USER_ID = #{findBudgetCapacityDto.userId} AND AC.PAYMENT_SIGN = 'EXPENSES' AND DATE(AC.PAYMENT_TIME) = CURDATE() GROUP BY AC.ID
UNION
SELECT AC.OUTLAY, CONCAT(CURDATE(), ' 00:00:00') AS DURATION_FROM, CONCAT(CURDATE(), ' 23:59:59') AS DURATION_TO FROM account_cost AC LEFT JOIN account_cost_user ACU ON AC.ID = ACU.COST_ID WHERE 1 = 1 AND AC.LOGIC_DEL = 0 AND AC.USER_ID <> #{findBudgetCapacityDto.userId} AND AC.PAYMENT_SIGN = 'EXPENSES' AND DATE(AC.PAYMENT_TIME) = CURDATE() GROUP BY AC.ID

SELECT AC.OUTLAY, DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) DAY) AS DURATION_FROM, DATE_ADD(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) DAY), INTERVAL 6 DAY) AS DURATION_TO FROM account_cost AC LEFT JOIN account_cost_user ACU ON AC.ID = ACU.COST_ID WHERE 1 = 1 AND AC.LOGIC_DEL = 0 AND AC.USER_ID = #{findBudgetCapacityDto.userId} AND AC.PAYMENT_SIGN = 'EXPENSES' AND AC.PAYMENT_TIME BETWEEN DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) DAY) AND DATE_ADD(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) DAY), INTERVAL 6 DAY) GROUP BY AC.ID
UNION
